note: 仅导出归属本人的已审阅字段；运行队列、凭据及其他用户资料不纳入导出。

datasets.name: logins
datasets.select: SELECT id,login_time,logout_time,login_date,duration,ipv4 FROM login_record WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM login_record WHERE user_id=?
datasets.eligible: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM login_record WHERE user_id=? AND login_time<?
datasets.cleanup: UPDATE login_record SET cell_phone='',ipv4='' WHERE user_id=? AND login_time<?

datasets.name: audit
datasets.select: SELECT id,method,object_path,result,http_status,created_at,finished_at FROM admin_audit WHERE actor_id=? ORDER BY id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admin_audit WHERE actor_id=?

datasets.name: sessions
datasets.select: SELECT session_id,audience,created_at,last_seen_at,expires_at,revoked_at,mfa_verified FROM auth_session WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY created_at,session_id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auth_session WHERE user_id=?

datasets.name: mfa
datasets.select: SELECT enabled,created_at,updated_at FROM auth_mfa WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY user_id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auth_mfa WHERE user_id=?

datasets.name: operations
datasets.select: SELECT operation_id,kind,status,error_code,created_at,updated_at FROM reliability_operation WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY created_at,operation_id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reliability_operation WHERE user_id=?
